get.description: Report detail by the org's human number (BUG-<number>); members only, 404 otherwise.
Dashboard cards: report counts by progress and the newest reports needing attention.

Reproduction metrics over `from`..`to` (to exclusive, default now; at most 90 days), or
the last `days` days (clamped to 1..90) when `from` is absent. Optional `program_id`.

Closed reports are hidden unless `include_closed=true` or `progress=closed`.
`from` is inclusive, `to` exclusive (created_at). Without `cursor` the response is
page-numbered (`page`, `total`). `sort`: `created_desc` (default) or `created_asc`; a
cursor must be reused with the same `sort`.
Widget submissions merged into this report, newest first (cursor-paged).
All runs of the report, newest first (cursor-paged).

Per-condition results of a condition-matrix job (409 NOT_CONDITION_JOB otherwise).
`most_progressed_condition_ids` counts completed steps; it is not symptom similarity.

Assignee.title: Assignee
Assignee.description:
`active: false` = no longer an active member of the report's org; the assignment is kept
but display_name/email are withheld (null) so a former member's contact is not exposed.

AssigneeUpdate.title: AssigneeUpdate
AssigneeUpdate.description: `user_id: null` unassigns. The user must be an active member of the report's org.

BestAttempt.title: BestAttempt
BestAttempt.description: Latest finished job's stored engine result, as redacted plain text (never HTML).

ConditionInfo.title: ConditionInfo
ConditionInfo.description: The registered condition as frozen in the job snapshot (no session reference).

DeveloperHandoff.title: DeveloperHandoff
DeveloperHandoff.description:
Plain data only (never HTML, links not followed). `state` and the analysis fields
(summary … classification) are the AI analysis (`ai_generated`); `diagnosis` is the
execution diagnosis with per-section provenance.

Diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description:
Deterministic run diagnosis (`source: execution`). Only `hypotheses` and
`missing_information` are model output, and they say so with their own `source`.

InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated
InviteCreated.description: The only response that ever carries the raw token.

JobMedia.title: JobMedia
JobMedia.description: `video_enabled` is null while the job runs or once its result is gone (retention).

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description: Public job view. No engine id, storage paths or scope snapshot.

JobRequest.title: JobRequest
JobRequest.description:
fresh: re-analyse from the stored report. retest: replay the baseline's stored plan
against an approved build. Expectations/steps/selectors are never accepted here.

NextStep.title: NextStep
NextStep.description: The plan step an attempt stopped before. Typed values are never returned.

ProgramResponse.title: ProgramResponse
ProgramResponse.description: Full view for members of the owning org.

ReportDuplicateItem.title: ReportDuplicateItem
ReportDuplicateItem.description:
A widget submission merged into this report (same error fingerprint within 24 h).
`description` is redacted plain text; `client_context` is the same whitelisted SDK
metadata the report itself keeps. The screenshot (masked) downloads through
`GET /evidence/{input_artifact_id}/download`.

ReportDuplicateList.title: ReportDuplicateList
ReportDuplicateList.description:
Newest first. Only the first stored duplicates are kept (see `duplicate_count` for
the total); the list is empty once the report's retention scrub ran.

ReportItem.title: ReportItem
ReportItem.description:
`progress` is the dashboard stage, computed from `workflow_status`, `fix_verified` and
the latest job (first matching row wins):

| workflow_status | latest job                                    | progress      |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------|---------------|
| closed          | (any)                                         | `closed`      |
| dismissed       | (any)                                         | `dismissed`   |
| received/fixing | (any), with `fix_verified`                    | `verified`    |
| fixing          | (any)                                         | `fixing`      |
| received        | none, `run_blocked = quota` (parked)          | `waiting_quota` |
| received        | none                                          | `new`         |
| received        | queued / running / cancelling                 | `reproducing` |
| received        | finished, verdict `reproduced`                | `reproduced`  |
| received        | finished, any other verdict or none           | `triaged`     |

Finished = completed / inconclusive / needs_info / failed / cancelled. `fix_verified` = the
latest *finished* job is a retest that ended completed + not_reproduced. Dashboard stages:
new → 신규 신고, reproducing → 재현 중, reproduced/triaged → 재현 완료, fixing → 버그 수정 중,
verified → 수정 확인됨 (awaiting a manual close), waiting_quota → 한도 대기 (stored over
the daily quota; a rerun `fresh` starts it), closed → 마감 (closed by a person, only
once the fix is verified). dismissed is a manual side exit.

ReportList.title: ReportList
ReportList.description:
Cursor mode (`cursor` given): `total`/`page` are null. Otherwise page mode: `page` is
the 1-based page and `total` the number of matching reports. `next_cursor` is always set
when more rows follow, so a page-mode client can also continue with the cursor.

ReportStats.title: ReportStats
ReportStats.description:
Over jobs/reports created in [`window_from`, `window_to`) (at most 90 days); `days` is
its length rounded up.

ReportSummary.title: ReportSummary
ReportSummary.description:
All of the org's reports (closed included), counted by `progress`; every value is
present, zero when none. `needs_attention`: newest 5 reports that are reproduced, parked
over the quota (waiting_quota), or still `received` with a required action from the latest
finished job (see `required_actions`).

TestAccountResponse.title: TestAccountResponse
TestAccountResponse.description: Status only. The password (and the full login id) is never returned.

VideoMedia.title: VideoMedia
VideoMedia.description:
One engine attempt's masked screen recording. `artifact_id` is set only for a stored,
hash-verified, unexpired file; status says why there is none (failed, unavailable, ...).

WorkflowUpdate.title: WorkflowUpdate
WorkflowUpdate.description: `closed` is accepted only while `fix_verified` is true (else 409 FIX_NOT_VERIFIED).
